text:
maya: Heads-up — we need to coordinate a base-image rebuild + RBAC cutover for the zero-trust service account onboarding. Goal: signed minimal image, KMS-signer rotation, and audit-forwarding to SIEM. Target window next Wed 02:00 UTC.

alex: ack. do we have the list of clusters and service accounts that will be affected?

maya: short list attached inline: platform-prod, platform-staging, inference-dedicated. svc accounts: infra-ops, runtime-pool, model-serving. we'll need role remapping for the new ephemeral SA pattern.

tariq: runtime note — the new images strip glibc debug symbols and drop a few utils. please confirm there's no dependency on /usr/bin/rsync in model-serving images.

jen_prod: from product side — can we keep a read-only fallback image in staging for feature flags? We want fast rollback if prompt-serving regresses.

alex: yes, plan is canary -> ramp -> full. we keep previous signed image in the image registry and a signed tag like `previous-signed-<ts>`. fallback policy will be implemented in the rollout config.

maya: RBAC changes: we will replace long-lived infra-ops SA with ephemeral-bound SA via WorkloadIdentity. Here's the kube snippet we'll apply in the rollout job:
```
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: RoleBinding
metadata:
  name: model-serving-ephemeral-bind
subjects:
- kind: ServiceAccount
  name: model-serving-ephemeral
roleRef:
  kind: Role
  name: model-serving-readonly
  apiGroup: rbac.authorization.k8s.io
```

kevin_oncall: question — who signs the cosign key and where's the KMS? we need to pre-authorize rotation steps so oncall isn't blocked at 02:00.

maya: cosign will use CloudKMS key ring `redwood-image-sign` in project `redwood-prod-keys`. rotation plan: create new key version, test sign in staging, then switch signer in the signing service. Docs: https://internal.redwood.dev/crypto/kms-rotation (internal)

alex: also ensure cosign public key is uploaded to our image attestation verifier and to the cluster admission webhook config. We'll update webhook config in a maintenance PR today.

deploy-bot: rebuild job queued: job_id=br-6601010101, images=3, signer=cloudkms:redwood-image-sign, expected_duration=18m

tariq: audit logging — we'll forward container runtime events and attestation outcomes to the SIEM. Can we confirm retention? Security wants 365d for attestation records. Is that feasible?

maya: yes, SIEM team agreed to 1y cold storage for attest logs. We need to ensure events are stamped with image digest, signer key version, and RBAC delta snapshot.

kevin_oncall: vuln triage: one blocker — CVE-2025-4242 in openssl in the base. Is it fixed in the new base?

alex: patched in the candidate base (ubuntu-minimal-22.04-patch2). I ran a quick SBOM and the CVE is absent. Will include SBOM.json in the artifact bundle.

jen_prod: for incident response, if the canary shows degradation, what's our rollback process?

maya: rollback plan: 1) abort rollout; 2) promote `previous-signed-<ts>` tag to `current`; 3) trigger webhook to invalidate caches; 4) open a short postmortem. Kept light — aim for <15m to restore.

tariq: one ops ask — during cutover, we need to temporarily increase logging level for model-serving pods so we capture early signs. I'll add `LOG_LEVEL=debug` in canary only.

alex: preflight checklist (short):
- publish candidate signed image + SBOM
- update admission webhook with new cosign pubkey
- create RBAC RoleBindings PR and get 2 approvals
- schedule KMS key version creation and test sign in staging
- notify SIEM for ingestion test
- dry-run canary in staging

kevin_oncall: +1 on approvals. oncall will be available during window. please @mention me in the rollout PR.

maya: timeline: today PRs open, tomorrow QA sign-off, Wed 01:30 UTC final approval gate, 02:00 start canary, 02:20 evaluation, 02:40 ramp if green.

alex: small ops note — we'll run a one-off policy scan after rebuild: `grype <image>` and upload results to the ticket.

deploy-bot: job started: job_id=br-6601010101, step=build, status=running

maya: thanks all. tagging follow-ups: @alex please post the RBAC diff, @tariq add LOG_LEVEL change to canary manifest, @jen_prod confirm rollback comms to customers if needed. :thumbsup:

alex: will do, PR link: https://github.com/redwood/infrastructure/pull/998 (draft)

kevin_oncall: I'll watch the canary and have rollback playbook open.

maya: closing note — after cutover we'll run an audit export for the governance team: include key IDs, signer key version, RBAC snapshot, and SBOMs.

jen_prod: thanks, good plan.

deploy-bot: job update: job_id=br-6601010101, step=build, status=success, artifacts=3, signed=true
